run_dpo_training: run DPO training for a causal language model using a config dict or LLMTrainingParams object
train_clm_with_dpo: train a causal language model with direct preference optimization using TRL DPOTrainer
configure_dpo_training_args: configure DPO training arguments including beta, max prompt length, and max target length
setup_peft_for_dpo: setup PEFT LoRA configuration for DPO training with optional int4 or int8 quantization
create_dpo_trainer: create a DPOTrainer instance with model, reference model, datasets, and processing class
